title: OraCalm: open, multilingual scoring for validated dental-anxiety instruments
description: OraCalm is a dependency-free Python library, command-line tool, and self-contained web demo that scores validated dental-anxiety instruments (the Modified Dental Anxiety Scale, Corah's Dental Anxiety Scale, and the faces version of the Modified Child Dental Anxiety Scale) using their published cut-offs and interpretation bands, with multilingual item sets. It is an educational and research aid, not a diagnostic device.
